name: VTF holding-reward mint on current balance
summary: VTF's holding reward mints 1% per day of an account's current balance for all the time since the account was first registered, so tokens moved into an old account earn rewards for time they were never held. The attacker registered 400 helper contracts two days early, then passed a flash-loan-bought VTF balance through them, each minting about 2% on top before forwarding it, and sold the inflated balance into the VTF/USDT pair.
notes: 0xc2d2d716 deployed the attack contract and registered the helpers (updateUserBalance) two days before; it moved no funds, so the drain 0xeeaf7e96 is the anchor. The pair held 23.6 USDT afterwards and earlier reward mints were at most 46k VTF each, consistent with ordinary holding.

Loss is the VTF/USDT pair's USDT outflow; 609.98 USDT of it reached the VTF contract through its own swap-and-liquify fee and is not subtracted. The changeSwapWarp call 89 blocks after deployment only sets the fee-swap helper and is not taken as a reset.
